# tools: add git-stack as alternative to graphite.dev

Try [git-stack](https://github.com/gitext-rs/git-stack), a CLI for stacked branches (rebase a chain of dependent branches together, sync, push), as the open-source counterpart of the [Graphite](https://graphite.dev) service. **Motivation:** "to compare in future."
